format: NDCA events: no-show couples and future entries

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: An organizer is not obligated to accept future entries from a couple that fails to appear without notice.

requirement: Any no-show consequence for NDCA events is limited to the organizer declining future entries; it never ties a refund to participation or results.
interpretation_notes: NOT IMPLEMENTED as a body control. Recorded to keep the distinction explicit: the pinned rulebooks tie no refund to participation or results, so refund-driven withdrawal (R12-DF-0003) and publication holds (R12-DF-0005) are DanceFlow policy only.
